I wish that I had these when I started working in a power plant back in the 60s. They are comfortable (come in 3 sizes for a perfect fit), secure (the little ribs lock them into the ear canal) and very effective (I don't measure this, but I can tell when it is quiet). Working in a power block for 6 hours a day with rotating equipment, compressors and the sounds of air, water, and steam flowing through pipes at high velocity means you will use hearing protection. I hate the little foamy throw-away types. These are without a doubt the most efficient, comfortable and reasonably priced hearing protection that I have had in over 40 years.)
